colorModel.auto.definition: The scan’s verdict: mono or one-shot colour, from the headers and pixels.
colorModel.auto.label: Auto

colorModel.mixed.definition: Mono and colour lights together: no single run can stack them.
colorModel.mixed.label: Mixed

colorModel.mono.definition: A monochrome camera behind a filter wheel.
colorModel.mono.label: Mono

colorModel.osc.definition: A colour (Bayer) camera: no wheel, the debayer makes RGB.
colorModel.osc.label: One-shot colour

filter.b.definition: Broadband blue filter of a mono camera.
filter.b.label: Blue

filter.g.definition: Broadband green filter of a mono camera (Johnson V reads as green).
filter.g.label: Green

filter.ha.definition: Narrowband filter on the 656 nm line of ionised hydrogen.
filter.ha.label: Hydrogen-alpha

filter.l.definition: Broadband clear filter of a mono camera.
filter.l.label: Luminance

filter.oiii.definition: Narrowband filter on the 501 nm line of doubly ionised oxygen.
filter.oiii.label: Oxygen III

filter.r.definition: Broadband red filter of a mono camera.
filter.r.label: Red

filter.sii.definition: Narrowband filter on the 672 nm line of ionised sulphur.
filter.sii.label: Sulphur II

filterSet.broadband.definition: Unfiltered or UV/IR-cut colour: full continuum, bright sky.
filterSet.broadband.label: Broadband

filterSet.dualband.definition: Colour through a dual narrowband clip (Hα + OIII): near-black sky.
filterSet.dualband.label: Dual-band

filterSet.unknown.definition: The pixels did not say whether the night was broadband or dual-band.
filterSet.unknown.label: Not measured

frame.bias.definition: Shortest possible dark exposures: the sensor’s read-out offset.
frame.bias.label: Bias

frame.dark.definition: Shutter-closed exposures at the lights’ time and temperature: thermal signal and hot pixels.
frame.dark.label: Darks

frame.darkflat.definition: Darks at the flats’ exposure, subtracted from the flats instead of the bias.
frame.darkflat.label: Dark flats

frame.flat.definition: Exposures of an even light: vignetting and dust shadows, per filter and per night.
frame.flat.label: Flats

frame.light.definition: Exposures of the target: the signal the stack is built from.
frame.light.label: Lights

frame.unknown.definition: Frames whose type neither the header nor the folder says.
frame.unknown.label: Unknown

frame.video.definition: Planetary or lunar captures (SER, AVI): listed, never stacked here.
frame.video.label: Videos

layer.line.definition: A narrowband layer of a bundle (Hα, OIII, SII), stacked on its own.
layer.line.label: Emission line

layer.rgb.definition: The one-shot-colour layer of a bundle: the debayered R, G and B.
layer.rgb.label: Colour

stage.calibration.definition: The masters each light set is calibrated with.
stage.calibration.label: Calibration

stage.data.definition: The nights, lights per filter, integration time and calibration coverage.
stage.data.label: Data

stage.export.definition: The deliverables: images and the recipe that made them.
stage.export.label: Export

stage.review.definition: Per-frame metrics: keep or reject each frame, pick the reference.
stage.review.label: Review

stage.stacking.definition: Registration, rejection and integration into the linear masters.
stage.stacking.label: Stacking

stage.studio.definition: Stretch, colour and stars on the stacked image, previewed live.
stage.studio.label: Studio
